lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots organized into three primary horizontal rows along the mid-section. The middle row features the largest and most distinct centroids, with increasing spatial intervals moving posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a discernible grid-like lattice, with spots acting as the anchor nodes of the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal carinae are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity light on the dorsal edge to deeper shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of approximately 6-8 distinct high-luminance blobs is visible within the macro-mask of the dorsal fin, concentrated mostly toward the leading edge and base.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a highly dense concentration of micro-spots, which are significantly smaller and more numerous than the primary macro-blobs found on the lateral flank.
